literal: Strict FDV >USD50M (equality No) for StandX platform token at16:00 ET on calendar day after launch, not24h. Launch requires active public transferability AND trading. Most-liquid price source; no qualifying launch byDec31 23:59ET meansNo. LateDec31 launch can requireJan1 16ET valuation despite API endJan1 05Z. DUSD stablecoin/reward allocation/pre-market derivative not automatically the platform token.

regimes.label: Oct15 cancellation persists; no qualifying launch
regimes.basis: Named official account says it will not proceed with token launch; DUSD airdrop instead; reduce-onlyOct20 and later exit deadlines. Current docs platform token not live.

regimes.label: Reversal or lawful successor launches bydeadline, then FDV test
regimes.basis: No irreversible prohibition: team/acquirer can reverse plan. 60% conditional FDV>50M is broad judgement without supply/venue/valuation data, not TVL-to-FDV conversion.

regimes.label: Unknown prior launch or disputed asset/source interpretation
regimes.basis: DUSD versus platform-token identity, missing tokenomics/most-liquid venue, unavailable full article; adjudication/identity uncertainty not zero.

sources.finding: Direct official post: token launch canceled, DUSD airdrop instead, operational dates. Raw hash root verified; core account identity and full note text inspected.
Undated page still distinguishes DUSD distributions and separate platform-token allocation, not yet live; unchanged latest body may lag Oct15 announcement.
Official timeline article preview; directGET404. Full article unavailable, no inference about Oct15 reward cessation or precise wind-down provisions.

limits: Cancellation statement is measured first-hand, but74day reversal/adjudication tail is not empirically bounded; use ordinary10pp instance reserve, not short-horizon K5 bond licence. Scenario rates/weights are primary judgement; no FDV inferred from TVL, users, token allocations, or DUSD marketcap. No unlaunched-address gap treated as proof of impossibility or mechanical exclusion.
